about:
# Foresight

The layman's oracle for official **WoW: Forever**. Foresight answers the question every
talent point and every stat on gear raises: *"+2 Spirit - so what?"* Answers always end
in human terms: extra casts per fight, seconds of regen saved, damage per swing. It's
not here to simplify the game or play it for you - it's here to give you insight, built
on a crowd-sourced, live-verified Forever database that sharpens as more players use it.

Three pillars (the first is the shipped core; the others are the roadmap):

1. **Talent, Item & Consumable Impact Map** - what each talent, stat, item, and buff
   actually does to *your* character, with what-if modelling before you commit - plus
   the opt-in crowd compare (ladders + daily challenges at wow-foresight.web.app).
2. **Panic Advisor** - what to press when things go wrong (planned).
3. **What-to-press HUD** - suggest-only rotation help (planned).

Status: pre-release, built against the Forever beta (Interface 16001, data build
1.60.1.70338). Forever launches 2026-11-04.

## Official download channels

When released, Foresight will be distributed **only** through:

- CurseForge
- Wago Addons
- GitHub Releases on this repository

Anything obtained anywhere else is unofficial and may have been tampered with. The
login message prints the addon version plus the game data build it was generated
from; if yours does not match a release on this page, you are not running our build.

## Account safety, by construction

Foresight is a normal `Interface\AddOns` addon using official APIs only, and it is
**display-and-advice only**: it never casts, targets, moves, uses items, or automates
any protected action. There is no memory reading, no input injection, no game-file
modification, and the addon never talks to the network.

This is enforced, not just promised: `pipeline/check_compliance.py` statically bans
every automation/protected API and sandbox escape, runs as the first step of the ship
gate, and a red result blocks any release. The full source is public so you can check.

## Installing from source (beta)

Copy the `Foresight/` folder into `World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns\`
(or your flavor's `Interface\AddOns\`). Then `/foresight` in-game; `/foresight selftest`
runs the built-in checks.

## Development

- `python pipeline/fetch.py` - download Forever DB2 CSVs from wago.tools
- `python pipeline/generate.py` - regenerate `Foresight/data/generated/*.lua`
- `python pipeline/run_tests.py` - compliance gate + headless selftest; THE ship gate
- `python pipeline/deploy.py` - gate-then-copy to a live install

Docs: `DESIGN.md` (product), `DATAFLOW.md` (architecture, threat model, publishing),
`FEASIBILITY.md` (platform research), `SPRINTS.md` / `FEATURES.md` / `CHANGELOG.md`
(work tracker / capability inventory / dev release history), and
`docs/RELEASE_NOTES.md` (plain-language "what works / known issues" for players).

releases.notes:
## 0.68.0 - bag arrows, the worth-wearing nudge, and a sharper model

At a glance: items in your bags that upgrade your current goal get a small
arrow - judged by the same honest net-swap verdict as the tooltip, spec-aware
(a Protection build marks tank upgrades), never on items above your level.
When a NEW upgrade reaches your bags, one chat line says so (Foresight never
equips anything for you). Too-high items keep their full verdict plus
"wearable at level N".

The model got sharper too: "Restores X per 5 sec" now counts (Survivability /
Mana sustain), per-school item damage (frost/shadow/fire/arcane/holy) is fixed
on the live client's key shapes, +Defense folds into avoidance, +Crit% folds
into crit - and tank verdicts with an armor-vs-health tension now explain
themselves ("the health side is +58 effective HP, the armor side -25").
Toggles: bagArrows, wearNudge.

Ship gate: Forever 331 checks, Classic 285. Display-and-advice only, official APIs only.

## 0.67.0 - guidance follows your talents + the quest best pick

Respec and Foresight respecs with you: a new Protection warrior engine ("The
Shield Wall Engine") leads the Matrix for prot builds, the auto gearing goal
turns tank-aware (Protection builds judge gear and next points by Tankability),
and every item tooltip now says WHOSE verdict it is - "(p) for your Protection
(0/5/41)" - straight from your live talents. Plus: hover a quest reward and
Foresight names the best pick of the offered choices, judged by the same honest
net-swap verdict.

Ship gate: Forever 326 checks, Classic 280. Display-and-advice only, official APIs only.

## 0.66.0 - chance caps & the boss frame

Foresight now interprets the chances the stock UI hides. Your insights
(`/foresight insights`) tell melee builds how often their swings miss vs
same-level targets AND vs +3 bosses (dual-wield penalty included), how much
+hit caps it, when a weapon-skill shortfall is quietly costing extra miss -
and casters get the spell version (the 3%/16% floors). Crit-talent tooltips
now also show your crit as it lands on a +3 boss. Advice lines, not a stats
HUD - and every number is tagged presumed until verified in-game on Forever.

Ship gate: Forever 324 checks, Classic 278. Display-and-advice only, official APIs only.

## 0.65.1 - now on Wago Addons

Foresight now publishes to Wago Addons alongside CurseForge - same addon, same releases,
pick your updater. No addon changes in this release.

Ship gate: Forever 322 checks, Classic 276. Display-and-advice only, official APIs only.

## 0.65.0 - under-the-hood cleanup

No visible changes - this release consolidates internals so everything stays consistent:
every green-up/red-down number now runs through one shared color helper, and the
"compare this item against what you're wearing" math runs through one shared fold used by
the verdict, the dimension rows, the per-spell lines, and the plan line alike - so they
can never drift apart.

Ship gate: Forever 322 checks, Classic 276. Display-and-advice only, official APIs only.
